messages:
michael: Heads-up — we've got a request from product to pull KMS audit logs for the last 90 days to help SAST/DAST triage a bunch of PRs. Asking if we can temporarily grant read access to the security team, and whether we should backfill logs into the SIEM. Any blockers with RBAC/KMS policy?
kaela: We can do it but need to avoid giving long-lived key access. Prefer creating an 'audit-reader' role with ONLY CloudAuditLogsViewer + a restricted view in the log indexer. No KMS decrypt permissions. :lock:
anjali: +1 on not touching key material. Also check PII/GDPR concerns before backfilling — some logs could contain user identifiers from staging. We might need field scrubbing or a legal OK.
tom: Also verify retention. If we're exporting, ensure the export destination is within our VPC bucket with server-side encryption and KMS key that only infra service accounts control. Don't let product or devs get access to the exported bucket.
kaela: Proposed steps: 1) create audit-reader role; 2) grant it to security SSO group for a 30-day window; 3) run a backfill job that writes to internal-log-sandbox; 4) run scrubbing pipeline and push to SIEM. I can draft the IaC.
michael: Sounds good. Do we need an incident ticket or change freeze?
kaela: Not a full change freeze but follow the RBAC rollout checklist: PR to infra-iam repo, design review, and 24h monitoring post-apply. Also add a temporary grant expiry in the role binding.
anjali: For SAST triage we also want ownership metadata on findings. Can we auto-assign a triage owner when a scanner produces a new finding and link to the log evidence?
tom: Yes — we can add a webhook from our SCA runner to the triage board that attaches evidence links. The key is stable URLs to the SIEM documents.
sre-bot: [deploybot] Automated check: infra-iam PR 762 missing doc link for 'audit-reader' expiration policy.
kaela: Thanks, will add. Also security note: do not surface full stack traces in the SIEM index — mask tokens and secrets with the scrubber. Example scrub rule: ```regex_replace("(api_key|token)=[^\s]+", "\1=[REDACTED]")```
michael: For the backfill job, any sample command for the log export?
kaela: Rough GCP pubsub export example: ```gcloud logging sinks create temp-backfill-sink storage.googleapis.com/internal-log-sandbox --log-filter="resource.type=\"kms_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt" --unique-writer-identity``` Then run a small runner that pulls objects and pipes through the scrubber.
anjali: Remember to run a small sample first and have legal vet the fields. I'll take point on the PII review.
tom: I'm going to draft the bucket IAM policy and the terraform for the sink. Will include the lifecycle rule to auto-delete after 60 days.
sec-oncall: If any of this enables broader access, tag sec-oncall and we'll monitor for suspicious queries. Add an audit SLO: any new query pattern that hits >1000 records will trigger an alert.
michael: Who owns the triage assignment automation?
kaela: I'll own the infra pieces. Anjali, can you own mapping scanner categories -> oncall rotation for 2 weeks while we test?
anjali: Yep, I'll own it for an initial 2-week burn-in.
sre-bot: [ci] Backfill job CI check passed for sample window (2025-01-15..2025-01-16).
michael: Great. Next steps summary: kaela PR for role + sink, tom PR for bucket IAM + lifecycle, anjali PII review + triage mapping, sec-oncall will add monitoring rules. We'll approve temporary binding for 30 days.
kaela: I'll open infra-iam PR shortly and tag reviewers. Adding the scrubber config and sample outputs to the PR description.
michael: Thanks all. If we get legal sign-off and infra PR merged, schedule the backfill for Thursday 03:00 UTC to minimize impact. :calendar: 
anjali: noted — will prioritize the PII checklist.
sec-oncall: I'll watch the run and escalate if anything odd shows up.
michael: closing the thread once PR numbers are posted. Appreciate the quick sync. :thumbsup:
